title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established international business based in Aylesbury.
Reporting to the number one of Finance , you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of the finance function, with exposure across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control, banking and month-end.
This is a varied, hands-on position where no two days will be exactly the same.
Your new role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices and payments
- Reconciling supplier statements and intercompany accounts
- Managing supplier queries and maintaining accurate account records
- Processing expenses and supporting accruals and prepayments
- Issuing customer statements and following up outstanding balances
- Resolving customer payment and pricing queries
- Raising invoices and credit notes
- Completing monthly bank reconciliations
- Reconciling retail sales, card payments, settlements and associated fees
- Supporting month-end reporting and audit requirements
- Assisting the Finance Manager with ad hoc projects and process improvements

What you'll need to succeed
You'll be an experienced finance professional with a strong eye for detail, a methodical approach and a genuine problem-solving mindset.
Ideally, you'll have worked in a similar hands-on finance role, with the confidence to investigate discrepancies, resolve complex queries and see issues through to completion.You'll ideally bring:
- Experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and account reconciliations
- Experience investigating and resolving complex financial queries
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- A proactive, analytical and problem-solving approach
- Good Excel skills and previous experience using accounting software
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers and colleagues
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a wider team

An AAT qualification or equivalent would be beneficial but is not essential.
You'll also have an interest in developing your systems knowledge and embracing new technology, including the appropriate use of AI tools to support financial processes and improve efficiency.
What you'll get in return
This is a great opportunity if you're looking for a role that offers more variety and responsibility than a traditional transactional finance position.You'll gain exposure across several areas of the finance function while working closely with the Finance Manager within an established international business.The package includes:
- £35,000-£38,000 depending on experience
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Hybrid working two days per week from home
- Flexible working around standard hours of 9am-5pm

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or contact us directly for further information.

Hays EA is a trading division of Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited and acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. title: Bookkeeper - Accountancy Practice
description:
Job title: Bookkeeper - Accountancy Practice

Salary: up to £38000

Location: Aylesbury

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Bookkeeper to join a well-established and growing accountancy practice. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the day-to-day bookkeeping requirements of a portfolio of clients, ensuring their financial records are accurate, up to date and compliant with relevant requirements.

This is an excellent opportunity for a bookkeeper who enjoys working with a variety of businesses and clients and is looking to develop their career within a professional accountancy practice.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing bookkeeping for a portfolio of clients across a range of sectors
- Processing purchase and sales invoices
- Recording bank transactions and completing bank reconciliations
- Processing payments and receipts
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records
- Preparing VAT returns and supporting clients with VAT-related queries
- Processing payroll where required
- Maintaining purchase and sales ledgers
- Credit control and monitoring outstanding payments
- Producing management accounts and financial reports
- Assisting with month-end and year-end procedures
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain information and resolve queries
- Working closely with accountants and other members of the practice team
- Ensuring bookkeeping is completed accurately and within agreed deadlines
- Using accounting software to maintain client records and process transactions

Requirements
- AAT qualification or working towards an AAT qualification
- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines
- Good communication and client-facing skills
- Confident using Microsoft Excel
- Experience with accounting software

title: Ward Clerk
description: The Emergency Medical Receiving Unit (EMRU) Ward Clerk provides comprehensive administrative, clerical, and reception support to the Acute Medicine service, ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the department. Working closely with the Acute Medicine leadership team, nursing staff, and multidisciplinary colleagues, the post holder acts as a key point of contact for patients, relatives, visitors, and healthcare professionals while maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism. The role is responsible for managing patient records, supporting clinical information systems, coordinating communications, arranging patient transfers, maintaining departmental documentation, and assisting with data collection and reporting requirements. The post holder also supports relatives and visitors, manages stationery and departmental supplies, assists with staff administration, and contributes to a safe, organised, and welcoming environment within the Emergency Medical Receiving Unit. By ensuring accurate administration, effective communication, and efficient coordination of non-clinical processes, the Ward Clerk plays an essential role in supporting patient care, service delivery, and the overall operational effectiveness of the Emergency Medical Receiving Unit. Provide administrative, clerical, and reception support to the Emergency Medical Receiving Unit. Act as the first point of contact for patients, relatives, visitors, and healthcare professionals, delivering a professional and confidential service. Answer and direct telephone calls, providing information within the scope of the role and Trust policies. Maintain accurate patient records and update electronic systems including Careflow EPR. Support data collection, entry, and reporting for audits, operational reports, and national submissions. Coordinate patient transfers, including transport arrangements and transfer of records and property. Manage departmental correspondence, mail distribution, and emails. Maintain records relating to patient valuables, donations, staff information, and departmental documentation. Monitor and order stationery and designated supplies, checking deliveries and reporting discrepancies. Support relatives and visitors, referring clinical enquiries to the appropriate nursing staff. Assist with staff induction processes and locker allocation. Maintain a safe, organised working environment and report maintenance or safety concerns. For a comprehensive list of responsibilities and duties, please kindly refer to the Job Description and Person Specification by downloading the JD and PS attachment in the advert. If you are an internal applicant there is the option for secondment, all applicants must have the endorsement/support of their line manager prior to application. If you have a disability that makes submitting this online application difficult and would like assistance, please contact us on bht.recruitment@nhs.net quoting the vacancy reference number.

title: Ward Clerk - Maternity
description: We are looking for a Ward Clerk to join our Maternity ward working a combination of 11.5 hour shifts Monday to Sunday (07:00 to 19:30). Shifts on Rothschild. The successful candidate will be welcoming the mothers on admission and supporting midwives, doctors and maternity support workers with their administration and discharge paperwork. The post holders would need to provide a courteous, efficient and professional ward clerk service, making a valuable contribution to support patient care from the time of admission, transfer or discharge. The successful candidates would be the first contact point for all ward visitors and members of the multi-professional team so good interpersonal skills are essential. We are looking for well-organized, enthusiastic individuals to work within our dynamic team, helping us to ensure our FORWARD behaviours are met and that care is delivered to the highest standard. You will need to be able to work flexibly and apply a methodical approach to a varying workload in what can be a fast paced, pressurized environment. You should be self-motivated, have excellent communication/interpersonal skills and have the ability to work on your own as well as part of a busy team where the work can be deadline driven. Previous NHS clerical experience is desirable and administrative and keyboard skills would be an advantage. The successful candidate will need an excellent telephone manner and must be able to deal efficiently with members of the public and all disciplines of hospital staff. For a comprehensive list of responsibilities and duties, please kindly refer to the Job Description and Person Specification by downloading the JD and PS attachment in the advert. If you are an internal applicant there is the option for secondment, all applicants must have the endorsement/support of their line manager prior to application. If you have a disability that makes submitting this online application difficult and would like assistance, please contact us on bht.recruitment@nhs.net quoting the vacancy reference number.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of administration duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include but are not limited to, scanning and processing of documents, processing and filtering medical reports and letters via DOCMAN; some reception duties including greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of information and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients letters, reports and other such documentation and ensuring the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. Greeting patients and visitors in a professional and friendly manner Answering telephone calls, booking appointments, and handling enquiries Managing patient check-ins and ensuring accurate registration details Processing repeat prescription requests and passing on messages to clinicians Maintaining patient confidentiality at all times Supporting the clinical team with general administrative tasks Filing, scanning, and updating patient records using clinical systems Liaising with other healthcare providers and services as needed Assisting with the smooth day-to-day running of the reception area Ensuring waiting areas remain tidy and welcoming The following are the core responsibilities of the administrator. There may be on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks; this will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: a. Receive correspondence from external agencies and process accordingly b. Scanning documents to the relevant software programme and logging them c. Filtering documents suitably according to need and passing to the relevant clinicians to read and action d. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies e. Photocopy documentation as required f. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences g. Input data into the patients healthcare records as necessary h. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner i. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times j. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested k. Completion of administrative tasks in relation to patient results and letters Secondary Responsibilities In addition to the primary responsibilities, the receptionist may be requested to: a. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system b. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments c. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately d. Signpost patients to the correct service e. Partake in audit as directed by the audit lead f. Action incoming faxes when necessary g. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records h. Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota No canvassers or recruitment agencies, please.
